liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station** (4 reviews): Reviewer calls the Terrapin into Stir It Up Jam sequence sublime; Terrapin into Stir It Up is called the highlight by this attendee [14][16][19][22]
- **Shakedown Street** (2 reviews): Reviewer describes Shakedown as thundering; says the entire second set smokes; Bob's guitar is out of tune at the start, loud in the mix; band covers until he returns around 3:30 [16][18]
- **The Other One** (2 reviews): Reviewer says the Other One, Wharf Rat, Throwing Stones, NFA closing quartet was nailed, though a standard sequence; Reviewer says The Other One pushes the band into a frenzy [20][22]
- **Wharf Rat** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out a stellar Wharf Rat and Quinn; Reviewer calls Wharf Rat nearly perfect [15][19]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Reviewer singles out New Minglewood Blues, Deal and Shakedown as amazing [24]
- **Mexicali Blues** (1 review): Reviewer says Mexicali sounds like an absurd carnival ride [14]
- **Saint of Circumstance** (1 review): Reviewer, present up close, yelled to Bobby to play Saint and the band played it after Iko [15]
- **The Mighty Quinn** (1 review): Post-drums material plus the Quinn encore described as blistering [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Stir It Up Jam**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1991-04-05.149628.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 190 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1991-04-05.133956.Nak300s-Senn441s.Baker.Keo.Flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 186 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Left channel problem briefly during Shakedown Street, and short pieces missing at tape flips [2]
- **gd1991-04-05.152099.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 19 songs; 187 min [7]
- **gd91-04-05.sbd.gardner.4162.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 170 min; rated 4.53/5 by 34 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer wonders if Jerry's vocals were overdubbed, since his pitch differs from the previous and next nights; Reviewer says the recording is pitch shifted; mostly fine, but some passages suffer from the change; Reviewer suspects the recording is sped up slightly, which might explain Jerry's differing vocals and the pitch-shift remark [19][22][23]

## Around the show

- Attendee was up close and counts it among favorites of about 40 shows attended [15]
- Reviewer attended Greensboro and Atlanta shows back to back, closing a run of five shows [20]
- Reviewer says the space section includes a train horn sound [24]
- Reviewer credits Bruce, not Vince, with firing up Jerry for nearly all of 1991 [25]
- Reviewer judges this the best of the Omni run, and thinks 1991 may have beaten 1990; Hornsby fully integrated [14]
- Reviewer says the 6-22-91 Shakedown rips even harder than this one [23]
- Reviewer says the show can even reach the level of 1969 performances [24]
- Reviewer ranks best Dead years as 1991, 1973, 1969, 1977 in that order [25]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1991-04-05.149628.FOB.Schoeps.Brotman.Metchick.Miller.Noel.t-flac1648**: taped by Master Digital FOB Recording by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick; transferred by Transfer by Charlie Miller Edited & Mastered using Adobe Audition by Joe Noel April 04, 2020; source: Recording: Schoeps CMC3 MK4’s (ORTF) > Panasonic SV-255 (16/48) Location: FOB mics hand held, section 5, row FF, seat 7 [1]
- **gd1991-04-05.133956.Nak300s-Senn441s.Baker.Keo.Flac2496**: taped by Baker; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Baker, Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns + Sennheiser 441's> Unknown Radio Shack Mixer > Sony D5,Tapes:Maxell MX… [2]
- **gd1991-04-05.152099.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 19, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [7]
- **gd91-04-05.sbd.gardner.4162.sbeok.shnf**: source: sbd> ?> cdr> eac> shn [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by bootlegsworldwide.blogspot.com: [BOOTLEG : Grateful Dead - The Omni, Atlanta, 5 April 1991 -SBD-](https://bootlegsworldwide.blogspot.com/2015/03/bootleg-grateful-dead-omni-atlanta-5.html) [27]
